whatThisIs: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), formerly known as EBT or food stamps, is a federal program that aims to help individuals and families pay for food. Physical cards, similar to debit or credit cards, are provided for purchasing food at approved grocery stores, pharmacies, and farmers' markets.
relatedLinkExplanation: HIP: Spend your SNAP/EBT money at select farmers' markets.
whoItHelps: Massachusetts individuals and families with limited income who need assistance purchasing groceries.
Households that may qualify based on their income, household size, and certain expenses.
whatToKnow: There are income, household, and expense eligibility requirements.
HIP (Healthy Incentives Program) is a supplementary program that allows you to spend your SNAP/EBT money at select farmers' markets.
You can apply for SNAP even if you already have WIC. Pairing the two can help maximize your budget.
